text:
I checked `chat-layout/requirements.md`, rewrote two things, and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`. `text-check` flagged nothing, so both fixes come from reading it against the checklist.

- **Shown, not told:** the layout was only described in sentences, so I added a drawn sketch. It shows the plain assistant text on the left, a one-word owner pill and a long wrapped owner bubble on the right, and the 80% limit.
- **Short:** the "A sibling at work" paragraph ran about 60 words, so I split it into a short list.

I didn't look at any page, because the proposal is a markdown file with no `page.js`.
